name: Severance
title: Artificial Turf in Severance, CO — Watering Schedule | NoCo Turf Co.
description: Severance waters on a mandatory schedule every year: 3 days a week by address, none from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m., and no lawn watering December 1 to March 31.
h1: Severance's mandatory watering schedule never takes a year off
lede: Severance grew from 7,683 residents in 2020 to an estimated 11,841 in 2025, and the Town's water users all follow one mandatory schedule, drought or not.

answer.question: What are the watering rules for a lawn in Severance?
answer.answer: Mandatory, every year. NoCo Turf Co. installs artificial turf in Severance, Colorado, where the Town's standing schedule allows 3 assigned days a week by address, no watering from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m., and no lawn watering from December 1 through March 31. An artificial turf area takes that lawn off the schedule.

blocks.h2: Severance's watering schedule is mandatory in every year, not just drought years.
paras: The Town requires all of its water users to follow the schedule: three assigned days a week by address, no watering from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m., and no lawn watering at all from December 1 through March 31.
A new sod lawn has to establish inside those windows; an artificial turf area doesn't need them.

blocks.h2: Severance owns its C-BT units, and North Weld treats and delivers them.
paras: The Town owns Colorado-Big Thompson water units that North Weld County Water District treats and delivers under a 2003 agreement, and its treated water comes through the Soldier Canyon Filter Plant. Northern Water set the 2026 C-BT quota at 0.8 acre-feet per unit.

North Weld also serves some subdivisions directly, including Belmont Farms, Bridal Hill and Saddler Ridge, Casa Loma, Hidden Valley Farm and Soaring Eagle Ranch; its 2026 rate is $31.14 for the first 6,000 gallons a month and $5.19 per 1,000 gallons after that.

blocks.h2: 97.4% of Severance homes are single-family detached, most built since 2010.
paras: About 69.2% of Severance homes were built in 2010 or later, with a median build year of 2014.

blocks.h2: Kim loam underfoot and 2.75-inch hail overhead.
paras: Soil surveys around central Severance map mostly low shrink-swell Kim loam and Otero sandy loam.

NOAA logged 2.75-inch hail on June 12, 2017 about 7.6 miles north-northwest of Severance, the largest Severance-referenced report from 2011 through 2025. The Greeley UNC station averages 58.3 days a year at or above 90°F.

faq.q: Does Severance regulate artificial turf on house lots?
faq.a: No such provision turned up in the town code as codified through December 9, 2025; its tree standards only define landscape to exclude artificial turf.

faq.q: Can I water new sod in Severance over the winter?
faq.a: No. The Town bars lawn watering from December 1 through March 31 every year.

faq.q: Who supplies water to my Severance subdivision?
faq.a: Check your bill. North Weld County Water District serves Belmont Farms, Bridal Hill and Saddler Ridge, Casa Loma, Hidden Valley Farm and Soaring Eagle Ranch directly; Town customers get Severance's own C-BT water, which North Weld treats and delivers.
